title: Unified State Architecture and Demonstrator Restoration
description:
Reach the target architecture and get the demonstrator working end to end.

TARGET ARCHITECTURE
- Every artifact has a schema, snapshot, diff, mutations, inferences, io system.
- Every artifact is tracked over vcs.
- Every artifact has children artifacts that have their own version history and referenced artifacts that also have their own version history.
- Every app consumes and produces artifacts.
- Every app has a headless engine, modes, config, presence, transient.
- Every mode has windows, config, presence, transient.
- Every window has actions, utilities, options, config, presence, transient.

STATE MECHANISMS (exactly 4, enforced by api and policies)
- artifacts = persisted shared state
- config = persisted local-only state
- presence = ephemeral shared state
- transient = ephemeral local-only UI state
Draft is transient ARTIFACTS (artifact-side concept), distinct from the transient UI lane.
StateClass final enum is strictly 4: { Artifact, Config, Presence, Transient }. Inferred leaves StateClass and becomes a separate derived marker. Preview folds into Artifact (draftness is a lane property). Effect is deleted.

THREE WORKSTREAMS
A. State-lane unification: PresenceStore (LWW roster) + TransientStore, Emit.presence_mutations/transient_mutations, Lanes view bundle, OsTransient absorbing the ViewModel overlay, OsShellConfig absorbing localStorage/prefs stores, taxonomy gains 🫧️transient plus modeChildDirs, mode/window scoped config/presence/transient facets, app headless ⚙️engine, policy enforcement making the 4 lanes exhaustive.
B. Composition made real: production TypedChildStoreFactory and MemberLinkResolver, child persistence over the spr channel (LoadChildren/Children frames), checkpoint composition_pins cascade, ArtifactView.children read seam, kill the thread_local child caches, extract/inline verbs, remaining W4 plugin fan-out prioritizing puzzle/procedural/sourcing, set-snapshot elimination, inference depth for composites, policy ratchet.
C. Demonstrator restoration: IO-registration ownership fix (cad and gis own their kinds), pane dissolution into 🎛️apps bundle, playground conformance, forced fresh WASM build, boot proof on port 6029, two-tab presence/config/transient demo, static ship.

Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-following-architecture-must-happy-possum.md. Sibling tickets UNIFIED-COMPOSABLE-ARTIFACT-SYSTEM and DISSOLVE-KERNELS-AND-MODULES-INTO-EVENT-SOURCED-ARTIFACTS stay owned by their sessions; coordinate on shared files, never git-modify, poll churn before each wave.
